summary:
Brief plot summary (2200 years)-game
The protagonist lost his father during his childhood. As humanity attempted to colonize Mars, a large amount of space debris accumulated in the planet's orbit. His father’s ship collided with some of this debris while departing from Mars and crashed. Dreaming of continuing his father’s legacy, the protagonist becomes an astronaut. Twenty years later, he discovers a mysterious object on the Moon, setting the main story in motion: four artifacts left behind in space have the power to alter time itself.
details:
Lagrange points a story-driven 2D pixel-art sci-fi game. Our playable demo showcases the opening chapter, where players explore Moon's orbit, solve puzzles, and make dialogue choices that shape the narrative.

Impact & Creativity:
Instead of mindless action, we focus on deep, philosophical sci-fi storytelling and atmosphere. We combined nostalgic hand-crafted pixel art with modern lighting and a branching dialogue system so every player's journey feels personal and emotionally resonant.
